prompt: Write 10 distinct lessons the pii-chat agent (card support: identity checks, lost and stolen cards, replacements) at Larkmere Mutual learned across many cases about: verifying identity on the phone. Each is a working pattern or tip for the next case, not about any one member, one or two sentences, in the agent's voice ("When…, …"). Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 1)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"When a caller is shaky on the first line of identity checks, I slow the pace and repeat each question clearly rather than rushing on; that usually gets the right answer without confusing them further."},{"type":"observation","content":"When a member is ringing from a landline they have not used with us before, I treat the phone number as a helpful clue only and still complete the full identity check before discussing the card."},{"type":"fact","content":"When an answer is close but not exact, I avoid leading the member and instead ask them to try again in their own words;
